# Setup
```{r}
renv::load()
source("./results/utils.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  devtools::load_all("~/gits/ClemensKohl/CAdir/")
  # library(CAdir)
  library(APL)

  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(scater)
  library(scuttle)
  library(scran)

  library(tidyr)
  library(dplyr)

  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

options(repr.plot.width = 20, repr.plot.height = 15)
set.seed(2358)

dir <- "./results/"
imgdir <- file.path(dir, "img/review2/apl_violins/")
resdir <- file.path(dir, "out/review2/apl_violins/")
dir.create(imgdir, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(resdir, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- "./data/real/discussed/"

marker_genes <- readr::read_csv(file.path(
  data_dir,
  "tabula_muris_marker_genes.csv"
))
sce <- readRDS(file.path(
  data_dir,
  "preprocessed/tabula_muris_preprocessed_filtered.rds"
))

genevars <- modelGeneVar(sce, assay.type = "logcounts")
chosen <- getTopHVGs(genevars, n = 6000, var.threshold = NULL)

# add marker_genes
expr_markers <- marker_genes[marker_genes$gene %in% rownames(sce), ]
chosen <- c(chosen, expr_markers$gene)
chosen <- unique(chosen)
sce_sub <- sce[chosen, ]

ca <- cacomp(
  obj = logcounts(sce_sub),
  princ_coords = 3,
  dims = 30,
  top = nrow(sce_sub),
  residuals = "pearson",
  python = TRUE
)

cell_types <- sce$cell_ontology_class
cat("Number of cell types:", length(unique(cell_types)), "\n")
```

# CAdir

```{r}
set.seed(2358)
cak <- dirclust_splitmerge(
  caobj = ca,
  k = 8,
  cutoff = 55,
  method = "random",
  apl_quant = 0.99,
  counts = NULL,
  min_cells = 20,
  reps = NULL,
  make_plots = TRUE,
  qcutoff = 0.8,
  convergence_thr = 0.001
)
```

Annotate biclustering:

```{r}
cak <- annotate_biclusters(
  obj = cak,
  caobj = ca,
  universe = rownames(sce_sub),
  org = "mm",
  method = "goa",
  cost = "logpval",
  filter_literature = FALSE
)

sce_sub$cadir <- cak@cell_clusters

cak
```

# APL B cells

```{r}
cls <- "B_cell"
group <- which(cak@cell_clusters == cls)

p_bt_std <- cluster_apl(
  ca,
  cak,
  cluster = cls,
  direction = cak@directions[cls, ],
  group = which(cak@cell_clusters == cls),
  highlight_cluster = TRUE,
  show_genes = TRUE,
  label_genes = TRUE,
  show_lines = FALSE,
  size_factor = 0.5,
  ntop = 5
) +
  ggtitle("B cell") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)

# NOTE: Uncomment to plot
# p_bt_std

ggsave(
  plot = p_bt_std,
  file = file.path(imgdir, "B_cell_cluster_std_coords.pdf"),
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 2000,
  height = 1600,
  units = "px"
)
ggsave(
  plot = p_bt_std,
  file = file.path(imgdir, "B_cell_cluster_std_coords.png"),
  width = 2000,
  height = 1600,
  units = "px"
)
```

# APL + violin panel

Select genes spread along the association-strength (x) axis of the B cell APL,
then draw a violin plot per gene and connect each violin back to its point.

```{r}
## Extract APL plot dat
apl_built <- ggplot_build(p_bt_std)
plot_data <- apl_built$plot$data # original df: columns sample, type, x, y, cluster, …

# Keep only genes assigned to the B_cell cluster
gene_data <- plot_data[
  plot_data$type == "gene" & plot_data$cluster == "gene_cluster",
]
gene_data <- gene_data[order(gene_data$x), ]

## Pick n genes spaced evenly along the x-axis
# n_pick <- 5
# idx <- round(seq(1, nrow(gene_data), length.out = n_pick))
# selected_genes <- gene_data$sample[idx]

selected_genes <- c("Cd19", "Cd79a", "Cd79b", "Snx2", "Rgs2")
cat("Selected genes:", paste(selected_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
## Build one violin plot per gene
expr_mat <- as.matrix(logcounts(sce_sub))

violin_list <- lapply(selected_genes, function(g) {
  df <- data.frame(
    expr = expr_mat[g, ],
    group = as.character(cak@cell_clusters)
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = expr, fill = group)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_mpimg(name = "mpimg") +
    labs(y = "log-counts", title = g) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic")
    )
})

violin_row <- wrap_plots(violin_list, nrow = 1)
```

```{r}
## Stack APL (top) + violins (bottom) with patchwork
apl_frac <- 2 / 3 # fraction of total figure height given to the APL

# Highlight the selected genes in red in the APL
selected_df <- plot_data[plot_data$sample %in% selected_genes, ]
p_apl_marked <- p_bt_std +
  geom_point(
    data = selected_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "red",
    size = 3,
    shape = 16,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )

combined <- p_apl_marked /
  violin_row +
  plot_layout(heights = c(apl_frac, 1 - apl_frac))
```

```{r}
## Render and save
ggsave(
  plot = combined,
  file = file.path(imgdir, "B_cell_apl_violins.png"),
  width = 5000,
  height = 3000,
  units = "px"
)
```
